headline: AMBER: tempo done but ran hot, PM spin already dropped, no further plan changes
summary: Today's tempo was done, but rep 2 ran above the band. Prescribed: 2x20min at 160-166bpm, cadence 170+. Rep 1 was in band: 18.7min at 4:27/km, 163bpm. Rep 2 ran over the ceiling: 18.0min at 4:35/km, 166 average, 168-169 from minute 5 and a max of 172. Both reps were short of 20min. Cadence was 172, which is on target. RPE 8, feel 2 (Good), load 72 for 65min / 13.1km. Running through the 168 stop rule is the same drift into Z3-Z4 we saw on Sun 25. Readiness this morning is AMBER because HRV is 54, under the 55 line. RHR is 51 and sleep was 6.4h. HRV dropped 6 overnight, which doesn't trigger amber on its own. CTL 55.5 has already reached the 55 start-line target, and ATL 68.5 puts TSB at about -13. Today's amber cut is already made: the PM spin is gone, so today counts as 72 instead of 105. No further plan changes. Fri 30 stays an easy 50min (45 load) with Sat's long run as planned. Freshness now matters more than adding load.
flags: Rep 2 sat at 168-169bpm against a 166 ceiling. On race day 166 is a cap until km 10, not where you start.
If HRV is still under 55 tomorrow: Fri becomes 35min at 138-150bpm with no strides. Sat 31 then uses its stop rule: 2 climbs, cap 1h50.
Sleep is the limiter. Bed by 22:00 tonight and Fri, early dinner with no alcohol before the Presolana long run.
